title: Latest Developments in Robotics and Humanoid Robots
query: latest developments in robotics and humanoid robots
summary: Humanoid robots face capability challenges but show rapid progress through competitions, commercial deployment, and global industry growth.

items.title: Technology Bottleneck
items.subtitle: Humanoid robots still struggle with efficiency and learning
items.body: Industry leaders report robots are not yet as efficient as humans and require significant time to learn new skills, creating a deployment bottleneck. Companies must demonstrate affordable, safe, and ready-to-use solutions.

items.title: Commercial Deployment
items.subtitle: Keenon ships 100K+ humanoid units
items.body: Startup Keenon has shipped over 100,000 humanoid robots for hotel laundry services, partnering with Buffalo Wild Wings and Hilton. Expects to exceed 150,000 units by end of 2026.

items.title: Global Competition Growth
items.subtitle: World Humanoid Robot Games expands dramatically
items.body: Second World Humanoid Robot Games features 2,056 robots from 666 teams across 16 countries - a 138% increase in teams and 4x growth in robots from inaugural event.

items.title: Regulatory Impact
items.subtitle: U.S. FCC restricts foreign humanoid imports
items.body: U.S. Federal Communications Commission added foreign-made advanced robotic devices to import restriction list, though current impact limited due to low U.S. humanoid adoption.

items.title: Market Focus Shift
items.subtitle: Solutions over form factor
items.body: U.S. customers prioritize problem-solving robots over humanoid appearance. Industry must prove value proposition before humanoid form becomes relevant.
